title: Because I know you more than anyone else

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: Sorry for the wait! I got some popcorn!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: ...Wait, where are the others?

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
...Over there. ...Opera O's doing...
what you expect.
I wouldn't go over there if I were you.

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
HAAHAHAHA!
Do not lament the end of the parade!
Let the Overlord of Century's End sing an
aria to soothe your woes!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Oh, okay. Haha.
Oh, my phone... Hello? Doto-chan?

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
(Wahhh~ Top Road-san! Sniff... sniff...
I got lost in the crowd...
Wh-where am I...?)

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
You'll be okay.
Just hang tight for a little bit.
...I'm going to go get Doto-chan and Opera
O-chan!

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
Both of them?
...I can go get one of them――

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
It's fine!
We wouldn't want someone to get lost again,
so feel free to wait here.
It'd be a great help if you held onto the
popcorn!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
(Ohh...
I was worried about what would happen if
they got separated,
but... Now that Top Road-san is back,
all those worries are gone!)

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
(Heheheheh,
now they're getting together for popcorn
time.
I can't believe I get to see this IRL...
Thanks for the fooooood~~!)

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Mm...
This döner kebab flavor has quite the unique
taste!
What flavor is yours, Top Road-san?

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Time for me to have some too...
Huh? It's not opening?
Nnnnnnngh!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: It's o-whwaaahh!? ――Ahh!! The popcorn!!!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Whoa there... You sure spilled a lot.
I'll go give the cleaners a heads up!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: ――Huh? Well, hey there, Digital-chan!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
HOUGH!!
...Aha... ahaha... W-w-what a co-co-coinkydink,
huh!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
It sure is.
So you're here with your friends too,
Digital-chan?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Er, no, I'm here alone...

text_block_list.name: Digital and Topro
text_block_list.text:
S-sorry, I'll leave now!
Alone? Well, how about you come with us?

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
See, well... We have a group of four right now,
so why not tag along? Plus,
it'll be easier to split up food and take
pictures with five of us!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
No, no,
I'm not worthy!
Butting my way into your hangout...
That's an INSTABAN! In Umamusume-chan fan law,
it's a crime of the GREATEST degree!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
...Wait, what? Hahaha, don't be silly!
If it's not too much, please,
feel free to join us, Digital-chan!

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Hey! Everyone!
It seems we can rent out outfits here!
Let us don the oufits of Fairyland,
and take plenty of photographs!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
O- outfits... Limited alts...! ...Wait,
no!
I can't get in their way any more!!
...But the FOMO's so strong...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
........Um~.... If,
purely hypothetically...
...If thou requirest a camerawoman, then,
perchance... I could...!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Of course you can come have fun with us!
But you don't have to worry about being the
camerawoman, okay?

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Hmmm... So many outfits to choose from.
How vexing.
I'd be so beautiful in all of them,
there's no way to choose!

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
...Hang on,
how come none of you have changed?

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Whoa... Ayabe-san,
you're so pretty!
This is an Ice Kingdom costume, right?

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
It is...
It was the simplest thing they had.

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Ah, so you're taking the role of the Ice
King.
Then perhaps I'll put on a black outfit to
contrast it.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Uh, um! ...C-can I...
Can I also wear black to match you?

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
But of course. You are free to take your pick,
Doto.
――What costume are you thinking of,
Top Road-san?

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: I'll just take the pictures!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
No, no, I'll handle camera duty!
This is a picture of your generation-mates,
we can't leave you out!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
I've already taken plenty of pictures with
everyone.
But we haven't taken a single one of you.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
No, no!
I tagged along specifically to take pictures!
I'm happy enough just knowing you were
thinking of me! No, actually,
I'm already over the moon!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Then... how about we both change?
We can take turns on the camera. 'Kay?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: ...Y- yesssss...!

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Camera duty... 
I don't believe that answers my question.

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
"The Overlord of Century's End",
T.M. Opera O. She is as the sun.
A light of hope that shines upon the people.
However―― Hope exists not only in the
light.

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Hope also lies in the shadows of avarice.
Unleash your heart's desires! Do not hold back.
Let me give you a taste of sweetest sin.

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
And fall―― Fall to my feet.
I await you in the abyss.
Together with my faithful Dotoberus.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Dotoberus...! Y-you even gave me a name!?
Ehehe~! I'm so glad to be a doggy~.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
...'Doggy'?
I think it's supposed to be Cerberus...
Didn't you pick the costume yourself?

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Um, well,
I wanted to be a demon like Opera O-san,
but...
I was so nervous pointing out what I wanted,
I ended up pointing at the doggy costume~

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
ASKLDLFK-DEMON!
The Overlord's fallen to the darkness...
NICE!!
The black-and-white contrast with Ayabe-san's
costume is just so, so, peak!!

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
――You there,
innocent girl. Don't you want...
a taste of sin?

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Wow, nice tempting!
I'm going to take a picture of this!
Doto-chan, Ayabe-san, can you get in frame,
too?
Okay, now hold that pose!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
――Whoa, it's already dark out!
Time really did fly. Hehe.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Oh, I'll send the pictures to the group LANE
once we get back!

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
Mmhm. Thank you.
We... we ended up putting you on camera duty,
didn't we...

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Don't worry,
Digital-chan took a bunch of pictures too.
We made a lot of fun faces in them,
so be sure to take a look through, okay?

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: ...I will.
